static_findings.title: Cleartext HTTP Traffic Permitted
static_findings.evidence: 31 unencrypted HTTP URLs discovered in code (e.g., http://apache.org/dav/propset/fs/1, http://apple.com/ns/ical/, http://calendarserver.org/ns/, http://calendarserver.org/ns/, http://calendarserver.org/ns/)
static_findings.description: The application allows unencrypted HTTP network communication. Traffic sent over plaintext HTTP can be intercepted, read, or modified by adversaries via Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks.

static_findings.title: High-Risk Sensitive Permissions Requested
static_findings.description: The application requests 1 sensitive high-risk permission(s). Overprivileged applications increase the attack surface and potential blast radius if the app is compromised.

static_findings.title: Hardcoded Private / Internal Network IP Addresses
static_findings.description: The application codebase contains hardcoded private RFC-1918 IP addresses (127.0.0.1). This indicates potential remnants of development/staging environments, exposing internal infrastructure topologies.

static_findings.title: Insecure file:// Local URL Schemes Detected
static_findings.evidence: Detected file:// scheme references in code: file:///android_asset/, file:///android_asset/, file:///android_asset/, file:///android_asset/, file:///android_asset/
static_findings.description: The application references local 'file://' URI schemes (5 occurrences). If passed to WebViews with allowFileAccess enabled, this can lead to arbitrary local file disclosure and Cross-App Scripting.
